description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the EligibleLeaveTypeAPI in the OrangeHRM Leave module. It contains test cases for the 'getAll' method and placeholders for 'create', 'delete', and validation rule methods, verifying API behavior and ensuring not implemented exceptions are thrown where applicable.
